name: Risk-on index regime momentum — LLM macro risk gauge gates the trend (long spot)
rationale: REGIME-SWITCHING on an LLM-as-judge macro gauge (risk_on_off x momentum). risk_on_off is a [-1,+1]-style LLM index that standardizes macro/geopolitical narrative into a single cross-asset risk-appetite score (the LLM proposes, the deterministic Gate disposes — never the money path). It is an ORTHOGONAL regime read to the price/funding/vol gates the existing momentum specs use: it reads the NARRATIVE backdrop (Fed posture, geopolitics, macro headlines) rather than market internals. The hypothesis: crypto momentum's premium is regime-conditional on the macro risk backdrop — gate the trend to fire only when the risk-on index is elevated (a supportive narrative regime). Mechanism before data: long spot when risk_on_off is above a fitted risk-on floor AND price ret is positive; exit when momentum fades or the index drops through a risk-off exit level. Distinct from reg-risk-derisk-momentum (a REGULATORY-specific index, not broad macro risk), g2-vix-calm-regime-momentum (equity-implied vol, a market-internal gauge), and g2-macro-regime-gated-reversion (FRED curve gating REVERSION, not momentum). Disconfirmer 1: drop the risk_on_off gate — if bare momentum matches the deflated Sharpe, the narrative regime adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: the LLM index is thin (few prod points so far) and updates slowly; if it is near-constant over the sample it selects nothing, and if effective-N is below the gate floor the min-trades guard catches it. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): risk_on_off is PIT at evidence-availability; net of ~20bps the gated momentum must clear. tier1 risk_on_off + tier0 ret_Nd, thin-but-fresh prod data — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: positive crypto momentum WHILE the LLM macro risk-on index is elevated (supportive narrative regime) — narrative-regime-gated trend, long spot
